title: What genres do you usually work on?
author: nonsalantan
selftext:
Hey everyone! Creating my own game has been a dream of mine my entire life, and now, with the help of AI, I can finally start working on it and I already have.  
I’m currently vibe coding a game, and I’m thinking about making something like a 2D battle arena, somewhat similar to Brawl Stars, or maybe an autobattler. I’m still deciding whether I want to focus on PvE, PvP, or possibly both.  
It’s definitely not as easy as it sounds, even with AI, but I’m learning as I go and having a lot of fun with it.

I’m curious what kind of games are you guys making? What genres do you usually work on, and how is your game development journey going so far?

comments.author: redditscraperbot2
comments.body: The kind that get you a gif of Dale from the walking dead posted under you.

comments.author: M4xs0n
comments.body: Actually I think 2D is way more confusing for me. I always worked in 3D. Most of the time first person prototypes of different genres.

comments.body: I start with the simplest game i wanted, hopefully i could get roi at least.
